description: Just go further – with the superlight and sporty standard e-bike with 24″ wheels for kids aged 7 years and over. See ya later, limits... Confidence is in town!

components.description: Sealed cartridge
Hydraulic flat mount disc brakes from Promax; Rotor diameter front/back: 160/140 mm; Adjustable, ergonomic brake levers designed for children
Cassette with 11–32 teeth
Narrow-wide chainring with 28 teeth
Lightweight, forged 130 mm aluminum cranks with narrow tread (Q-factor)
microSHIFT Acolyte RD-M5185S rear derailleur

MAHLE XS30 drive unit with 250 W of power; Battery capacity of 171 Wh (corresponding to a range of around 50 km on flat terrain in the lowest power mode); 45 Nm torque; 25 km/h assistance limit, three power modes; External, removable battery (1.2 kg); Can be controlled via the MAHLE app and the button on the battery; Option to ride as normal without the battery
Lightweight aluminum unicrown fork; 1″ steerer tube; Generous trail angle for easy, well-balanced handling
Ergonomic grips; Slim, child-specific diameter; Targeted comfort zone prolonging the onset of fatigue on long rides; Lock-on design holding the grips securely on the bars
Wide, lightweight aluminum bars with an ergonomic design and child-specific tapered ends to suit smaller hands; Sandblasted and anodized in black; Width: 580 mm
Fully integrated 1″ headset; Sealed industrial-grade bearings; Integrated Ahead plug
15 mm spanner for pedals; 4 mm hex key for stem
Narrow, flat platform plastic pedals
Super comfy; Ergonomic design, specific for each frame size/age; Developed in collaboration with Selle Royal
Anodized aluminum seatpost with minimum insertion mark; Handy ABC marking making it easier to adjust saddle height in relation to the bars/stem
Made of aluminum; Long quick-release lever, easy to operate requiring only minimal strength; No risk of turning and/or twisting; Integrated shim preventing the seatpost from being scratched
microSHIFT Acolyte trigger shifter

Superlight stem made out of forged aluminum; Adjustable height and reach of stem offering an optimal riding position as the child grows; Handlebars attached via two clamps and fixed with two 5 mm hexagon socket bolts; Handy ABC marking making it easier to adjust the handlebars in relation to the saddle height

24 × 2″ Billy Bonkers folding tires (Performance Line) from Schwalbe; Agile, grippy all-terrain tires with low rolling resistance; Reflective stripes on the sides of the tires for maximum visibility even in low-light conditions

Ultralight aluminum rims; Aluminum hubs with sealed bearings and mount for woom click-on mudguards; Quick-release axle on front wheel for easy removal/fitting; Bolt-on rear wheel; 24 lightweight, super strong stainless steel spokes, double-crossed spoking
